name: ntfy
description: Push task events to an ntfy topic (ntfy.sh or a public HTTPS self-hosted server).

settings.label: Topic URL
settings.description: HTTPS topic URL such as https://ntfy.sh/my-topic. Private/LAN hosts are rejected.

settings.label: Access token (optional)
settings.description: Bearer token if the ntfy topic requires authentication.

settings.label: Triggers
settings.description: Choose which events should notify this topic.

settings.label: Only notify when status changes (for task.updated)
settings.description: When enabled, task.updated is skipped unless the kanban or list status actually changed.
